headline: Maine’s Hancock County GOP.
introduction: The Hancock County Republican Committee is the county organization for Republicans across Hancock County, Maine.
missionText: We connect local Republicans, support candidates, share information about elections and public issues, and encourage participation in town, county, and state government.

values.title: Community
values.description: Keeping the committee connected to towns and neighbors throughout Hancock County.

values.title: Participation
values.description: Helping residents take part in elections, meetings, campaigns, and local government.

values.title: Service
values.description: Supporting candidates and volunteers who are willing to serve their communities.
